claim.claim-text: 1. A vehicle (12), comprising:

a sensor (18) configured to detect projections on a surface, each projection comprising a light projected characteristic associated with a desired vehicle occupant experience; and a controller (20) configured to:
2. The vehicle (12) of claim 1, wherein the input is provided by a passenger of the vehicle (12).

3. The vehicle (12) of claim 1, wherein the controller (20) is further configured to change selection of the light projected characteristic based on indication of a modification of the desired vehicle occupant experience.

4. The vehicle (12) of claim 1, wherein the vehicle (12) comprises a front wheel located near a front of the vehicle and a back wheel located near a back of the vehicle (12), and the controller (20) is further configured to control the front wheel to follow a first projection and the back wheel to follow a second projection.

5. The vehicle (12) of claim 1, wherein the sensor (18) is configured to scan the surface (46) to detect that an abnormality has occurred in the light projected characteristics projected on the surface.

6. The vehicle (12) of claim 1, wherein the controller (20) is configured to communicate with other vehicles (12) about: selection of the light projected characteristic of the projection, a particular location of the vehicle (12), a speed of the vehicle (12), a future change in the light projected characteristic of the projection, or any combination thereof.
7. A system (10) comprising a vehicle (12) as claimed in any of the preceding claims, the system further comprising:

the first projection comprising a first light projected characteristic, the first projection configured to provide the first vehicle occupant experience; a second projection comprising a second light projected characteristic different than the first light projection characteristic, the second projection configured to provide the second vehicle occupant experience;
8. The system (10) of claim 7, wherein the vehicle (60) is disposed on the first projection, wherein the controller (20) is configured to guide the vehicle (60) along the first projection.

9. The system (10) of claim 8, further comprising: a second vehicle (62) disposed on the second projection, wherein a second controller is configured to guide the second vehicle (62) on the second projection concurrently with the vehicle (12) being guided along the first projection.

10. The system (10) of claim 7, wherein the first light projected characteristic comprises a center portion (72) with a first light projected characteristic and a first portion flanking (74) the center portion (72) comprising a different light projected characteristic than the first light projected characteristic.

11. The system (10) of claim 10, wherein the controller (20) is further configured to guide the vehicle (12) to move toward the center portion (72) in response to detection of the different light projected characteristic by the sensor (18).
12. The system (10) of claim 7, wherein the controller (20) is further configured to:

identify, via the sensor (18), a third light projected characteristic of the first projection, or the second projection, or both that is associated with the matching light projected characteristic; and control the vehicle (12) to follow the matching light projected characteristic in accordance with a control action associated with the third light projected characteristic.

13. The system (10) of claim 12, wherein the third light projected characteristic changes at different locations along the first projection, or the second projection, or both to indicate different control actions for the controller (20) to implement at the different locations.
